sloka: ससूत्रवृत्त्यर्थपदं महार्थं ससङ्ग्रहं साद्ध्यति वै कपीन्द्रः ।नह्यस्य कश्चित्सदृशो ऽस्ति शास्त्रे वैशारदे च्छन्दगतौ तथैव ।। ७.३६.४७ ॥
transliteration: sasūtravṛttyarthapadaṁ mahārthaṁ sasaṅgrahaṁ sāddhyati vai kapīndraḥ ।nahyasya kaścitsadṛśo 'sti śāstre vaiśārade cchandagatau tathaiva ।। 7.36.47 ॥

translations.english: The chief of monkeys, Hanuman, indeed masters scriptures with their aphorisms, commentaries, meanings, and words, along with their summaries, and truly, no one is his equal in knowledge, skill, or prosody.
